core_obligations: Uses a completely bounded-polynomial Bohnenblust-Hille inequality plus coefficient estimation to classically learn polynomials produced by d-query quantum algorithms from logarithmically many-in-n random examples; this is a separate learning model and main result from quantum channel query learning.

Distinct author main theorem and its completely bounded inequality proof; support inequalities and unitary/Pauli special cases are not separately counted.
